decisions.reason: Mobile flail shredding builds directly on the firm's mobile machinery and service know-how, so it can still learn from field results and refine the line, although its absence from the website in 2020 to 2021 raises real withdrawal risk.

The firm already withdrew the closely related green-waste grinder (Product E), and this grinder had only a mention and no website presence in 2020 to 2021, so it gives too few signals to learn from and its resources are better spent on the core mobile line.

A stationary electric fine shredder lies furthest from the firm's mobile core, the stationary pre-shredders (Product F) were already withdrawn, and it was not visible after 2019, so the firm lacks the related knowledge and feedback to develop it further.
